json_bytes: lowercase hex, exact bytes, no normalization; text exact UTF-8
cbor: Existing writfold-wire engineering::cbor encoder. Arrays only; shortest signed/unsigned integers and lengths. JSON object order irrelevant; no omitted optional fields. Null distinct from empty.
semantic_constraints: Labels limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes (JSON Schema length alone is not sufficient); no Unicode control characters.

Scope uses existing root RealmId and RunId plus concrete worktree RepositoryId, WorktreeId and BindingRevision. RequestKey uses existing ActorId, RealmId and RunId. Scope references require exact ASCII token spelling [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]* bounded to 4096 bytes. ActorId retains its existing opaque grammar with this profile's label bounds. BindingRevision is not an ownership or request generation. Nominal conversion preserves existing golden bytes exactly.

Strict bounded RawJson rejects duplicate/unknown/missing keys, exponent/fraction integers, negative unsigned fields, invalid UTF-8 and trailing bytes. POSIX seconds alone accept signed i64 integers, excluding negative zero. Caller supplies Limits for both JSON and CBOR.
Capture literal POSIX-relative path has no empty/dot/dotdot segments or backslash. This is lexical containment only; host must enforce no symlink/escape race.

POSIX mode contains regular file type and permission bits only; links exactly one. Exact mtime and ctime each bind signed i64 seconds and nanoseconds in 0..999999999, without rounding. Same-byte timestamp changes alter capture identity. These observations do not prove absence of ABA or confer authority.
Raw content length and SHA256 must match retained bytes.

Splices preserve pinned Splicery normalized order: ascending original-byte offsets, start <= end, no overlap; equal boundaries allowed only when both targets have positive width. Each edit preserves exact replacement bytes and its recipe-origin start/end. No merging, deletion of empty edits or rejection of unchanged replacements. Empty batch is representable data, never permission to dispatch.
Read ranges nonempty individually, sorted and nonoverlapping (adjacency allowed), checked against exact original bytes; the explicit read-set array may be empty.

validate_prepared requires exact scope and recipe/capture/candidate references, recipe-origin bounds and byte derivation. Compiler/kernel artifact hashes are bindings only, not attestation or proof of recipe evaluation. No-change classification and host dispatch eligibility are separate from this descriptor.

Observation content unobserved iff hash null; confirmed requires candidate/durable/preserved; no-effect requires original/preserved. Other combinations remain untrusted typed data. validate_observation binds exact intent/stamp/prepared and checks original/candidate/other hash dimensions.
Stable request key includes authenticated principal, realm, run and opaque bytes only. Host authenticates principal separately.

RequestMapping separately binds key to Engineering EffectIntentDigest and nominal worktree::EffectId. EffectId is an exact ASCII token [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,255}, not a content digest. Persist atomically insert-or-compare; no overwrite. Current head/grant/owner/resource generations belong to DispatchStampDigest.
No existing 16-kind engineering registry changes and no SG08 digest reinterpretation.
proof_scope: Runtime structural/byte-consistency checks only; no new Verus proof claimed. SHA256 collision resistance, truthful retained bytes/artifacts and host authenticated identity/native observations are assumptions. Decoding never creates effect authority or a trusted outcome.
verification: Component domain/wire/runtime/source tests and real native consumers exercised; see qualification/status.json owner component evidence. No new Verus proof, owner-service admission or full SG08/WF25/WF27 pass.
